Toe kick and lower overhang
Both inside faces mirror to the same front cutout: 75 mm deep × 100 mm high.
Stopped bottom grooves start at the rear of the toe recess; the overhang stays intact.
Bottom face Z100; inside floor Z118. Shelf bottom Z401; top inside face Z702.
Back panel: measured blank and physical engagement
Before: 576 × 696 mm. After: 582 × 602 mm, entering all four 9 mm grooves.
Back occupies X9..591, Y530..548, Z109..711 mm. The 12 mm setback is clear space behind its rear face.
Shelf depth changes from 548 to 530 mm; it meets the front of the back without penetrating it.
Computational verification
1,911 assembled depth sections checked; zero material intersections beyond 0.004 mm NC rounding allowance.
All six blank spans checked from actual cut contours. Nominal outside dimensions and groove engagement preserved.
Finite-tool dogbone relief is included. This is not a physical assembly trial; feeds and tool inventory are unchanged.
Source/NC hashes, panel placements and sampling: assembled-fit-measurements.json.
